### IMAP, briefly

*  built for multiple "mailboxes" ($\approx$ folders), messages kept on server
*  "idle" command
   *  server tells you proactively if "subscribed" folders updated
*  extra metadata for each message
   *  flags: seen (read), answered, flagged, deleted, draft

### IMAP states

*  "not authenticated"
*  "authenticated"
   *  list, subscribe to, select mailboxes
   *  IDLE command --- wait until server has updates for subscribed folders
*  "selected" (a particular mailbox)
   *  download, update (e.g flags), copy, move messages
   *  can list headers (without download messages)
   *  can have server search for messages
